cs.t: I recommend Truly Ergonomic keyboard [1] for coding. I am using the old model, so I cannot talk about the new CLEAVE model. The old one is compact, has mechanical switches, the function key can be changed; like swap Ctrl with Alt key. I used to have pain in my wrists. With Truly Ergonomic thankfully it disappeared. Before that, I spent a year and money using different keyboards. So, it can be used to prevent wrist pains. [1]  https://www.trulyergonomic.com/
